# Brookdale Named One of America’s Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces® for 2026


By Brookdale Media Relations


- [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=)
- [Twitter](https://twitter.com/home?status=)
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/shareArticle?mini=true&url=)


### About Brookdale Media Relations


**


***Recognition reflects Brookdale’s commitment to its associates and culture***


**BRENTWOOD, Tenn., November 19, 2026 –** Brookdale Senior Living, the nation’s largest publicly traded operator of senior living communities and third largest owner of senior living real estate, has been named to the 2026 America’s Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces® list, developed by Best Practice Institute (BPI) and featured in *The Wall Street Journal* .


The recognition follows Brookdale earning Most Loved Workplace® Certification earlier this year and reflects how associates experience the company’s culture, including whether they feel respected, believe in the organization’s future and see their values reflected in how Brookdale operates.


At Brookdale, creating a workplace where associates feel valued and supported is fundamental to delivering quality care for residents. Guided by its mission of enriching the lives of those it serves with compassion, respect, excellence and integrity, Brookdale continues to focus on strengthening trust, accountability and connection across the organization while creating opportunities for associates to grow and make a meaningful difference.


“Being named one of America’s Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces is a tremendous reflection of our associates and the culture we are building together,” said Brookdale Chief Executive Officer Nick Stengle. “Our associates bring compassion, dedication and purpose to our communities every day, and they are what makes Brookdale such a special place to work and live. When our associates feel valued, supported and empowered to do their best work, that translates directly into more purpose, connection and joy for the residents and families we serve.”


Brookdale’s focus on associate experience includes listening to associate feedback, supporting professional development and creating opportunities for associates to connect their individual roles to the company’s broader mission. The company believes investing in its people strengthens its ability to attract and retain talented associates while supporting the quality and consistency of the resident experience.


“This recognition is especially meaningful because it reflects how associates experience our culture,” said Brookdale Chief Human Resources Officer Jaclyn Pritchett. “We want our associates to know their voices matter, to see opportunities to grow and to understand the important role they play in our mission. We will continue listening, learning and investing in our people as we work together to make Brookdale an even stronger place to build a career and serve others.”


**How the recognition is determined**


BPI’s research uses the proprietary Love of Workplace Index® to assess employees’ emotional connection to their organization. The underlying SPARK model examines collaboration, a positive vision for the future, alignment of values, respect and achievement. Employee feedback provides evidence of how those qualities are experienced at work.


“What separates these organizations is that accountability does not belong to a select few. People throughout the organization are encouraged to contribute ideas, take ownership, solve problems, and help move the business forward. They create opportunities for people to grow, trust and respect one another, and turn ideas into action,” said Louis Carter, founder and CEO of Best Practice Institute and creator of the Most Loved Workplace® certification and rankings.


For more information about Brookdale Senior Living or to explore career opportunities, visit **brookdale.com** .
